parts.text: This question is about zinc salts.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Excess solid zinc oxide is added to dilute sulfuric acid to produce a salt.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Complete the word equation for this reaction. [2] zinc oxide sulfuric acid .......................... .......................... .......................... + +

ms.label: 5(a)(iii)
ms.text:
1 mark each for any 2 of:
•
evaporate to point of crystallisation OR evaporate until saturated solution is formed OR heat until crystals just appear
•
filter off crystals / pick out crystals
•
dry with filter paper
